explanationReview.sourceComparison: Selected complete method sections, full relevant ACL pages and named author-code functions read. Source scopes are listed below; full-paper/full-repository review is not claimed.
explanationReview.noisyStudent: Clean inference-mode teacher versus noised student; separate training rounds and fixed soft targets; CE equals target entropy at matching predictions while its logit gradient is zero; batch-ratio reduction; filtering/balancing and unique versus repeated entries; iterative-run protocol; distinct 2021 language SSD adaptation.
explanationReview.mixText: Discrete IDs versus continuous token-state interpolation; identical state/target coefficient; shared lower-branch gradients and nonlinear upper predictions; sampled layer and folded Beta coefficient; weighted guess before sharpening and ties; differentiable squared-norm margin versus detached targets; stationary uniform prediction; paper/released-code differences in averaging, hinge and loss assembly, and no-grad versus eval.
explanationReview.daiLe: Complete-document reconstruction versus prefix LM; shared encoder/decoder LSTM weights and teacher forcing; vocabulary-head disposal, transferred embeddings/recurrent weights and supervised adaptation; full forward sequence versus truncated backward graph; non-universal experiment outcomes and the internal IMDb v1 disagreement.
explanationReview.assumptions: Semi-supervised smoothness, cluster/low-density separation and manifold geometry distinguished from class information, using existing circles and graph examples. A label change halfway around a curve is a counterexample to inferring a single class from low-dimensional shape.
